The Impact You'll Make
 Danfoss Group IT is seeking an experienced developer to forefront our integration initiatives and drive the continued improvement of our application portfolio in Azure cloud. In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying robust and scalable enterprise-level integrations.
You will be part of the Digital Customer Experience (DCE) team, with more than 125 international colleagues, where we develop, support, and lead the digital customer experience in Danfoss. We connect business needs and IT into digital solutions.
If you are passionate about building innovative solutions on Azure and have a proven track record of delivering high-quality results, we encourage you to apply with your cv in the English language. The position is open in our locations in Slovenia, Croatia, Poland and Romania.
 The job shall be hybrid. 
 What You’ll Be Doing
Design and implement event-driven integrations (Azure Event Grid and Azure Service Bus) and serverless functions following MACH principles.
Utilizing Azure CDN to serve assets and ensure the best possible user experience.
Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using Bicep.
Ensure adherence to Microsoft Azure security best practices and industry standards including access controls, data encryption, and vulnerability management.
Establish and maintain a robust CI/CD pipeline using Azure DevOps to automate the build, test, and deployment processes.
 What We're Looking For
Proven professional experience in Azure integration technologies, including Azure Functions, Azure Event Grid, Azure Service Bus, and Azure API Management.
Strong proficiency in .NET development and C#.
Solid understanding of serverless architectures and cloud-native principles.
Expertise in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Bicep or Terraform.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and tools like Azure DevOps.
Deep knowledge of security best practices and compliance standards.
Strong communication and collaboration abilities.
Proficiency in spoken and written English.
 What You'll Get From Us
We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.
You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.
We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.
Together with your employment we provide non salary benefits that we share with your during the recruitment process.
 Ready to Make a Difference?
 If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category
